entities.summary: Załęże is a part and a district of Katowice, located in the north-western part of the city, in the central part of the Upper Silesian conurbation, on the Rawa river. It runs along Gliwicka Street in a characteristic, winding course from the city center to the border of Chorzów. It also borders Osiedle Tysiąclecia, Dąb, Śródmieście, Załęska Hałda-Brynów, and Osiedle Witosa.
